objective: AI Supervisor Backend Foundations — Add scoped service API keys, SupervisorReasonCode enum, source/primary_reason_code in system_events, alert dedup lookup & write endpoints, and per-topic liveness tracking.

acceptance.criterion: service_api_keys table and auth middleware allow scoped machine credentials.
SupervisorReasonCode enum provides bounded reason codes for AI supervisor.
system_events schema includes source and primary_reason_code columns with constraints.
find_recent_alert dedup lookup correctly checks cooldown and source isolation.
POST /api/devices/{id}/events and recent-check endpoints perform scope validation and dedup.
Per-topic last-seen tracking and GET /health/topics endpoints function accurately.
